q: OSI model mein sabse upar wali layer kaun si hai?
explain: OSI mein upar se neeche: Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link, Physical.

q: Network layer (L3) par data ko kya kehte hain (PDU)?
explain: L3 par PDU packet hai. Transport par segment, Data Link par frame, Physical par bits.

q: TCP aur UDP OSI model ki kaun si layer par kaam karte hain?
explain: TCP aur UDP Transport layer (L4) par kaam karte hain, ports ke through process-to-process delivery.

q: ARP OSI model mein kahan fit hota hai?
explain: ARP L3 ka IP le kar L2 ka MAC nikaalta hai, isliye wo L2 aur L3 ke beech kaam karta hai.

q: TCP/IP 4-layer model OSI ki kaun si teen layers ko ek Application layer mein milata hai?
explain: TCP/IP 4-layer model OSI ki Application, Presentation aur Session ko ek Application layer mein mila deta hai.
